goal: Create a single self-contained index.html implementing an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (#060913). Include: 1) Responsive full-window <canvas id="canvas"> using requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling. 2) Central glowing star using createRadialGradient and a subtle corona pulse. 3) At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, colors, at least 3 moons/satellites, and fading orbital trails. 4) Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars. 5) Interactive glassmorphism HUD overlay with: Play/Pause button (#btn-play-pause, text 'Pause'/'Play'), Trails toggle button (#btn-trails, text 'Trails: ON'/'Trails: OFF'), Reset button (#btn-reset), Speed range slider (<input id="speed-slider" type="range" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">) with live multiplier readout (#speed-value showing e.g. '1.0x'), live FPS (#fps showing integer), simulation time (#sim-time showing e.g. '0.0s'), and active burst particle count (#burst-count showing integer, '0' initially). 6) Clicking anywhere on #canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out. Keep everything self-contained in index.html with zero external dependencies.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html with zero external dependencies.
Valid inline JavaScript syntax with no runtime errors.
Canvas uses requestAnimationFrame and devicePixelRatio scaling.
Central glowing star rendered with createRadialGradient and corona pulse.
At least 5 orbiting planets with distinct orbital radii, speeds, and colors.
At least 3 moons/satellites orbiting around planets.
Twinkling background starfield with at least 150 stars.
Glassmorphism HUD overlay containing controls and live readouts.
#btn-play-pause toggles play/pause state of the simulation.
#btn-trails toggles orbital trails between 'Trails: ON' and 'Trails: OFF'.
#btn-reset resets simulation time, burst particles, and planet positions.
#speed-slider (min=0.2, max=3.0, step=0.1, value=1.0) controls simulation speed.
#fps displays the live frames per second.
#sim-time displays the elapsed simulation time in seconds.
#burst-count displays the active burst particle count.
Clicking #canvas spawns a radial burst of glowing particles with velocity damping and fade-out.
